title: Ahsoka Tano
snippet: Ahsoka Tano (/əˈsoʊkə ˈtɑːnoʊ/; ə-SO-kə TAH-no) is a fictional character in the Star Wars franchise. She was introduced as the 14-year-old Togruta Jedi

title: Star Wars: Ahsoka
snippet: the events of the film Return of the Jedi (1983). Ahsoka follows former Jedi apprentice Ahsoka Tano and her allies as they defend the fledgling New Republic

title: Star Wars: Ahsoka season 2
snippet: (2019–2023) after the events of the film Return of the Jedi (1983). It follows Ahsoka Tano and her Jedi apprentice Sabine Wren as they are stranded in another galaxy
